item.title: Inviting hard questions

item.title: Redeploying Fable 5
item.description: [Announcements] Fable 5 returns globally July 1. We're also proposing an industry-wide framework for scoring jailbreak severity, together with Amazon, Microsoft, Google, and other Glasswing partners.

item.description: [Product] Sonnet 5 delivers frontier performance across coding, agents, and professional work at scale.

item.title: Claude Science, an AI workbench for scientists, is now available
item.description: [Announcements] Claude Science is a customizable app that integrates the tools and packages researchers most often use, produces auditable artifacts, and provides flexible access to computing resources.
